messages:
maya: Hi everyone  Hi! Onboarding question: my dentist booked a cleaning for 4/2 but I haven't gotten an insurance card or confirmation. My start date was 3/23 and I picked 'first of month' for benefits. Is there an emergency card or proof I can show?
people-ops: Welcome @maya! Congrats on joining. If you DM your employee ID we can check enrollment and ask benefits to push an e-card.
maya: DM'd ID 47899. Thanks.
ana (Benefits): Hi @maya  I see 47899 in the benefits portal. Effective date is 2026-04-01 so coverage will be active for 4/2. Carrier hasn't produced a physical card yet but we can send an e-card to your email or a benefits confirmation letter for your appointment. Which do you prefer?
maya: E-card would be perfect. Also curious about HSA contributions showing on my paycheck stub  I selected HSA-employee-only but the deduction seems higher than expected.
tom (Payroll): Hey @maya. For HSA, deductions depend on the payroll calendar proration. If your benefits start 4/1 but payroll cycles cut mid-month, first deduction can be pro-rated. Can you share the pay period dates? DM the stub if needed (redact SSN).
maya: It's pay period 3/16-3/31 on this stub. I'll DM the screenshot.
people-ops: Quick note: if you opted into commuter benefits later in the onboarding flow, those start the next payroll cycle after enrollment. For relocation card questions, that team will send a separate welcome email.
ana (Benefits): E-card sent to your work email and also uploaded to your Workday documents. You should be able to download a PDF at the 'Benefits > Documents' panel.
maya: Got the e-card PDF  thank you! That should be enough for the dental office.
tom (Payroll): Received your DM, thanks. I flagged your HSA election for manual review. Looks like the system applied a full-month deduction because the election was processed before the enrollment effective date was finalized. I'll correct it and the net adjustment will appear on the next payroll. If you need the corrected year-to-date numbers for budgeting, I can share the recalculation after the next run.
maya: Appreciate that. Last thing  any holiday proration for my start date I should be aware of? My manager mentioned floating holiday eligibility.
people-ops: For PTO and company holidays we prorate based on hire month. Floating holiday eligibility starts after 90 days for new hires. We'll add a note in your offer file with exact proration dates.
people-ops-bot: Reminder: please complete I-9 and direct deposit setup in Workday to avoid payroll delays.
maya: Done with I-9 and direct deposit. Thanks again everyone! :smile:
